title: The optional "transcription" object of meeting.json (schemaVersion stays 1)
description: Additive, optional block. Meetings without it are valid and mean "no transcription". `transcript` describes the transcript that is committed in the folder; `job` describes the most recent run that is running or did not finish. Both can exist at once (re-transcription). The folder content wins over this block (see transcript-folder.md, status resolution). At implementation this schema is merged into meeting.schema.json as $defs/transcription and referenced from an optional property "transcription".

failureMessage.description: Short English technical detail for people reading the folder; the UI shows a localized text for failureReason.

resumable.description: True when transcript.work.jsonl holds a usable checkpoint.
